capabilities: Sync YouTube video metadata from Web Clipper notes into a cache
Generate per-video watch/skip verdicts with an AI provider
Surface recurring themes across the backlog
Flag time-sensitive videos whose value has expired
List low-value videos that are safe to delete
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not summarize or recap video content; it only produces verdicts and themes from metadata.
extras: Freemium: 3 total video syncs free (stored per-vault locally, no server), Pro on Gumroad unlocks unlimited syncing. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian. No transcripts are fetched because YouTube blocks client-side caption requests; small free models tend to under-skip.
motivation: The author frames large watch-later backlogs as a source of accumulating guilt and argues the real question is whether anything worth the user's time was missed, not whether everything was watched.
problem: Watch Later lists grow faster than anyone can watch them, and there is no way to tell whether anything worth watching was missed without watching every video.

relations.evidence: expects watch-later videos as Obsidian notes produced by the official Web Clipper

requires.name: Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or custom OpenAI-compatible provider
Pro license on Gumroad for unlimited video syncs

summary: LLM-based triage tool that generates watch/skip verdicts, recurring themes, and a safe-to-delete list for a YouTube Watch Later backlog.
